countingRules: Count completed go test -json events carrying Test; omit package-only pass/fail events.
Top-level Test names have no slash; subtests have slash. Parent failures propagated from child failure are separate events, not independent assertions.
Numbers equal their derived name lists; running names and package exit alone do not prove completed coverage.
A parse failure, timeout, compile failure, missing selected case or unexpected SKIP is incomplete, not a behavioral kill or zero-test pass.
Commands selecting both M01 BEGIN/normalization tests must account for both names. Baseline current FL membership22 top-level/28 events is an expected cross-check, not data to paste.
Combined FL/affected regression membership40 top-level/87 events is an expected cross-check from disjoint independent R2 selection; derive actual R3 results and disclose any deviation.
proseRule: Generate totals/assertion names from actual receipt. Preserve R1/R2 attribution limits; no manually populated fake run values. This contract contains no execution receipt.
